ledger.spent: DERIVED - summed from the owned rows, never stored as a counter
ledger.why: two numbers describing one fact drift apart the moment anything writes one without the other (an interrupted save, an item removed from the shop, a hand-edited profile), and then the balance is wrong for ever with nothing to compare it against
ledger.price_recorded_per_purchase: so re-pricing an item later cannot retroactively change what an existing player has left
ledger.buy_returns: a word - ok / owned / poor / unknown - not a boolean, because the screen has to say WHICH happened

store_version.why: achievementNormalize returns an EMPTY store when the version does not match, so bumping it to make room for `owned` would have silently DELETED every achievement every existing player has earned. An absent `owned` reads as {}.

insanity.visibility: ABSENT from diffList() until owned, not drawn-and-disabled
insanity.why_absent_not_disabled: 'you cannot select it' is three claims - the cursor, the mouse hit test, and the function that turns the cursor index into a difficulty key. This repo has shipped a menu where FOUR places knew the row count and one was missed. One list closes all three doors.

vault.why: until this screen existed nothing could be bought at all - the ledger and the INSANITY unlock were provably correct and furiousBuy had no caller outside code. A system with no surface is indistinguishable from one that was never built (the same hole ACH-02 found in the achievement registry).
vault.reached_from: the achievements gallery, on its own button (CHARGE/X) - CONFIRM already cycles the filter there
vault.pending_rule: a row that cannot deliver is refused BEFORE the points are checked - selling a video that does not exist leaves the player out the points with nothing to show, and the refund path is exactly the bookkeeping the derived balance exists to avoid
